call_points.text: Management expects a net positive financial year, with most growth from SSSG plus new-store productivity.
Store rationalisation tail is guided at about 3-4% of stores in a typical year.
Most FY27 gross store openings will start only at the end of Q2 and early Q3.
Franchisee capex is about ₹2,100-2,150 per sq ft in Tier 2/3 cities and ₹2,500 in Tier 1.
Franchisee breakeven revenue per sq ft is about ₹7,000 in Tier 3, ₹8,500 in Tier 2 and ₹10,000-10,500 in Tier 1.
MBO, SIS and e-commerce together are about 5% of revenue, with aggressive growth targets.
Premium brand Twamev outperformed the company on growth; Mohey is growing above the company average.
Gross margin improved to 65.7% in Q1FY27 from 65% in Q4FY26; GST enters the base only from Q3.
Inventory was 34 days for the trailing twelve months to June 2026.
Cash conversion (operating cash flow to PAT, excluding finance income) was about 101% for the twelve months to June 2026.
UAE and North America, the two main international markets, are under pressure from war and tariffs.
September-October may be softer this year as Adhik mass shifts Navratri; November to March is expected to be strong.
Internal research across 8 top states shows store counts starting to fall, with large competitor stores closing.
Retail sales for Q4 FY26 grew 7.8% YoY to ₹561 crores, with SSG at 4.6%.
Q4FY26 gross margin stood at 65% and EBITDA margin at 45.6%.
EBO network stands at ~1.79 million square feet across 669 stores in 252 cities.

timeline.summary: Vedant Fashions Limited’s **Navin Pareek** (ICSI Memb. No.: F10672) schedules Q4FY26 & FY26 conference call for **May 11, 2026, at 3:30 PM IST**, featuring **Vedant Modi** (CRO) and **Rahul Murarka** (CFO).
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹399.43 Cr (+8.7% YoY), net profit ₹114.3 Cr (+13.0% YoY).
Vedant Fashions released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation on May 8, 2026, highlighting steady retail sales growth and brand expansion.
Vedant Fashions received an Order-in-Appeal upholding a ₹1.01 Cr ITC demand and ₹1.01 Cr penalty for FY18-FY20.
Vedant Fashions hosted its Q4FY26 earnings conference call detailing retail sales growth and network expansion strategy.
Ravi Modi HUF, Ravi Modi, Usha Devi Modi, Shilpi Modi, and Ravi Modi Family Trust filed annual SEBI pledge disclosure for FY2026, confirming no encumbrances on shares.
On 27 July 2026 Vedant Fashions held its Q1FY27 earnings call, reporting revenue of ₹301 Cr (+7.2% YoY), PAT of ₹81 Cr (+14.7%) and domestic SSG of 3.8%.
Vedant Fashions Limited schedules a conference call with management on Friday, November 06, 2026 at 3.30 PM IST to discuss Q2FY27 results.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for final dividend of ₹7.75 per share

watchlist.target: high single-digit for balance of FY27 (analyst framing management called fair)

watchlist.text: Gross margin as GST enters the base

watchlist.response: Management said franchisees have made good ROI over the last couple of years and there is no pressure; breakeven revenue per sq ft is about ₹7,000 in Tier 3, ₹8,500 in Tier 2 and ₹10,000-10,500 in Tier 1.
watchlist.text: Franchisee store economics under pressure for over three years, with GST rate changes possibly squeezing franchisee margins.

watchlist.response: Management attributed closures to market shifts, larger nearby stores and a few bad openings, and said large-store closures were deliberately pulled into Q1 ahead of the off-season Q2.
watchlist.text: Accelerated store closures despite competition normalising.

watchlist.response: CFO said auto-replenishment means primary and secondary can diverge quarterly and asked analysts to review both at full-year level.
watchlist.text: Gap between primary sales growth (3-7%) and secondary sales growth (~3%) in a quarter hit by Adhik mass.

watchlist.response: Management said the situation is similar to the last call and it will comment once most FY27 openings are done at end-Q2/early Q3; no fresh number given.
watchlist.text: Whether new stores are really ~85% more productive per sq ft than closed stores.

watchlist.response: Management said it is too early to conclude and would want another 2-3 quarters of data.
watchlist.text: Whether falling competitor store counts are translating into better growth in those regions.

watchlist.response: Management gave a rough figure of about 5% combined, without a precise split.
watchlist.text: Salience of MBO, SIS and e-commerce in total revenue.
